annotation.title_clean: Richtsnoeren inzake transparantieverplichtingen voor aanbieders en exploitanten van AI-systemen
annotation.title_en: Guidelines on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of AI systems
named_instruments_referenced: Code of Practice on transparency of AI-generated content
annotation.summary_en: European Commission library page (Dutch) announcing guidelines on the transparency obligations for providers and deployers of AI systems under Article 50 of the EU AI Act. The obligations apply from 2 August 2026. The guidelines are meant to help authorities and operators apply them consistently. The page links to the guidelines and related materials but has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: The AI Act follows a risk-based approach with four risk categories, including AI systems that carry transparency risks
Article 50 transparency obligations apply from 2 August 2026
The Commission adopted the guidelines to give practical guidance to competent authorities, providers and deployers
The aim is consistent, effective, proportionate and uniform compliance with Article 50
Links to the downloadable guidelines, the approval communication, a Q&A, a fact page and the Code of Practice on AI-generated content
